title: QUIC RFC 9000 Verifiable NEW_TOKEN Envelope Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, fuzz/property mutation coverage, Release build, permanent BenchmarkDotNet Dry harness validation, regenerated coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and full no-build solution tests.
scope: This verification covers the first listener-scoped NEW_TOKEN envelope and server pre-admission validation floor.
expected_result: Issued NEW_TOKEN values are distinguishable as NEW_TOKEN tokens, unique for repeated issuance, integrity protected, IP-bound, and expiring. Valid tokens allow future Initial admission without Retry; invalid tokens are validated and treated as unvalidated, including Retry emission when Retry bootstrap is enabled.
procedure: Run the focused S8P1P1/S8P1P3/S8P1P4 requirement-home filter.
Run the address-validation token BenchmarkDotNet Dry filter.
Run the full no-build solution test suite.
preconditions: The listener owns a token protector and passes it to server runtimes.
The client Initial packet contains either a Retry replay token or a NEW_TOKEN value.
Replay-cache and one-time-use token enforcement remain outside this verification scope.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim one-time token use, replay-cache enforcement, token persistence across listener restarts, public token-cache APIs, or complete observer-linkability closure.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04 with the Release build, focused requirement-home filter, BenchmarkDotNet Dry token suite, regenerated coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON core validation, and full no-build solution suite.
